name: hash-sip13
algorithm: std SipHash-1-3 under the key (0, 0) over splitmix64 bytes, reps passes with a one-byte write-back (mk/hash-sip13.mk).

skip.c: no std hash: C has no standard SipHash
skip.go: no std SipHash: Go std has none (hash/maphash is a different, seeded hash); no module stands in

notes: Idiomatic standard library: one call of each language's std function per pass (plan/06-m6.md 4.1). Bytes per second = mib * 1048576 * reps / median.

Key (0, 0): Rust's std::hash::DefaultHasher::new() is SipHash-1-3 under (0, 0) (write then finish, no length prefix); Zig takes the 16 zero bytes; Mk zero-fills one HashKey with Arena.Slice[HashKey](1), which D-306 makes the key (0, 0) (HashKey.Of(0, 0) is the same key once std.core has it).

Checksums: Mk (mk build -release), Rust 1.99.1 (-C opt-level=3 -C target-cpu=x86-64-v2) and Zig 0.17.0 (-O ReleaseFast -mcpu=x86_64_v2) printed the same values for args and quick on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 3). The publish-size checksum was re-agreed by every column in `go run ./tools/bench verify -publish-size` on the owner's machine, 2026-11-07 (std-hashmod session 5, after the reps were raised, Mk then skipped; session 7 restored the Mk column under D-306 and checked it prints the same). Not published: no number here is a measurement.
